positions.title: System Engineer/Product Manager
positions.description:
System Engineer (ATCA Shelf)
Product Manager (Front Panel)
----
Researches, collects, and reports information on the ability and capacity of company products and competing equipment. Aids in the design and development of equipment and systems, and redesign of existing systems to fulfill the needs of customers. Responsibilities also include providing equipment functionality and capability reports to the sales force, and acting as technical liaison to the sales team

Deals out cards to patrons for games of chance. 
Supervises players, checks hands for winnings, and collects or pay out chips accordingly.

positions.title: Liquor Store Clerk
positions.description:
Liquor sales, Stocking and Store operations,
----
Greets customers and answers questions regarding product content, use and price.
Observes customers, checks identification for proof-of-age and denies service to underage or intoxicated customers.
Receives payments by cash, check or credit card and makes change, receives shipments.
Arranges shelf and floor displays, opens and closes store and maintains security.

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
Stock Super Market Shelf
----
Greets customers and answers questions regarding product, receives shipments; arranges and stock super market shelf and build floor displays,

positions.title: Library Clerk
positions.description:
Routine circulation, shelf maintenance and clerical functions using automated circulation system.
----
Charging books in and out, shelving library materials, data inputting, and telephone answering. This position is also invested with making beginning level library clerical decisions.

positions.title: Produce Clerk
positions.description:
Proper stocking and rotation of merchandise in the produce department, 
----
Trimming, watering, and merchandising of products to ensure fresh, high quality offerings. Also responsible for proper inventory control to maximize product freshness and availability, and answer questions from customers about produce products and help increase sales by recommending additional items to customers.
